spec_match.rationale: Builds the exact four directives the explainer defines (report-to, entry-types, include-user-timing, capture-early-failures) in structured-field syntax, and the server emits the real Performance-Observer + Reporting-Endpoints header pair.

interactive.rationale: Checkbox grid seeded from the browser's real PerformanceObserver.supportedEntryTypes, live header preview, and a real same-origin fetch whose actual response headers are read back and displayed.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature index promises a builder with a real server round-trip; the page delivers exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Server-side validation rejects unknown entry types and malformed mark names and the page surfaces the rejected sets; unsupported entry types are labelled and start unchecked.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/6594955352080384 and the explainer's syntax section.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite probes the exact underlying contracts (supportedEntryTypes membership per type, mark detail round-trip, ReportingObserver) plus the honest forward-looking session-end probe that fails until the proposal ships.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via CDP: clicked #send, read back HTTP 200 with the negotiated Performance-Observer header, zero console errors, zero failed requests; full-page screenshot inspected at desktop width plus the responsive-check mobile matrix.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert('dpo-header-echo-roundtrip') fires on both success and failure branches with status detail.

design_system.rationale: All colours are CSS variables; buttons keep the global dark-bg/light-text pair; monospace output panels use bg-stone/text-charcoal (AA).

accessibility.rationale: Native checkboxes inside fieldset/legend groups, 44px minimum control heights, output uses aria-live=polite and the fetch result uses role=status; all controls are keyboard-operable native elements.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: deno task responsive-check v151/declarative-performance-observer: desktop and mobile both ok, no horizontal overflow, console/network clean; auto-fill checkbox grid reflows to one column at 360px.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the round-trip when Chrome ships an implementation
openQuestions.detail: The page states no browser processes the header yet. When a flag or origin trial appears, the banner must gain exact enable steps and the round-trip should be re-tested behind the flag so the page can show real browser processing (e.g. a delivered report).

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Group related controls with fieldset/legend, use native checkboxes with visible labels, and keep touch targets comfortable.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: entry-types, include-user-timing and capture-early-failures are each a fieldset with a legend; native checkboxes have 44px-tall label rows and accent-color from the design system.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce async results via live regions and keep status output programmatically associated with the action.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The header preview is an <output aria-live=polite>; the fetch result panel uses role=status so the round-trip result is announced.

summary: Verified with headless Chromium 141 over CDP (chrome-devtools-mcp is not available in this cloud routine): built the header from live checkboxes, clicked send, and read the real negotiated Performance-Observer/Reporting-Endpoints headers off the response with a clean console and no failed requests. Desktop and mobile screenshots inspected; conformance route shows 7 pass / 1 expected fail (session-end, pre-incubation).
